judged_text: The only positive test verifies delegation by mocking poll_feed, so the entire poll_feed body — SimpleRSS parsing, the i.link/i.id URL fallback, CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub), and the TopicEmbed.import call — is never executed by any test (checked spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb, the only spec in the diff referencing PollFeed; every test interacts with poll_feed solely via mocha expectations). A regression in feed handling (e.g., i.content raising NoMethodError on feeds without a content element, or the URL fallback picking i.id) ships undetected; with sidekiq_options retry: false the hourly job then dies and imports silently stop in production.
